question: What evaluation criteria and point values are used to score proposals in the Delaware Office of the State Treasurer's 2021 RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping and administration services?
gold_answer: Total 100 points: (I) Vendor History and Depth of Public Defined Contribution Plan Experience - 10; (II) Scope of Vendor Operations and Ability to Meet Full Range of Requested Services - 20; (III) Plan Sponsor Experience: Website Access & Quality, Administrative and Compliance Support, Relationship Management, Performance Reporting and Industry/Trend Evaluation and Communication - 30; (IV) Participant Communication & Education: Custom Website, Voice Response System and Participant Call Center; Commitment to Customer Service/Issue Resolution; Custom Communication and Education Capabilities, Branding, Onsite Representatives and Guidance/Advice Tools - 30; (V) Overall Cost to Plans and Plan Participants - 10.
acceptance: Five categories with 10/20/30/30/10 points, correctly distinguishing plan-sponsor from participant services. Exhaustive examples within categories are optional.
candidate_answer:
The RFP scores qualifying proposals on a **100-point scale**:

| Evaluation criterion | Points |
|---|---:|
| Vendor history and depth of public defined-contribution plan experience | 10 |
| Scope of vendor operations and ability to provide the full range of requested services | 20 |
| Plan sponsor experience, including website access, administration and compliance, relationship management, reporting, and industry/trend communication | 30 |
| Participant communication and education, including website and call-center services, issue resolution, customized materials, onsite representatives, and guidance tools | 30 |
| Overall cost to the plans and participants | 10 |
| **Total** | **100** |

Proposals are first screened for timeliness and compliance with minimum qualifications and other requirements. The RFP notes that neither the lowest-priced nor the highest-scoring proposal is necessarily selected. Source: *Delaware Office of the State Treasurer, 2021 RFP*, Section VI.B, pp. 19–20.
